coordinate_convention: band: right to left 0..7; col: left=0,right=1; row: top to bottom 0..23
user_coordinate: 第4小列（从右往左）倒数第2小格
cause: The bottom page rule touched ordinary glyphs in both small columns, merging them into a full-width component. Large-row protection treated that component as a two-row large glyph and skipped the genuinely empty preceding cell.
fix: Before large-glyph component analysis, remove only rows that cover over 65% of the major band and lie within 15% of one cell height from the measured top or bottom boundary. Interior wide strokes remain unchanged.
